name: Dosukebe Mama♪ ~Boku no Mama wa, (Seiteki ni) Chou Kahogo~
original_name: ドスケベ・ママ♪～ボクのママは、（性的に）超過保護～
source:
This is my usual morning routine. Yes, my mom is extremely overprotective.

I was leading an ordinary life, but then an incident happened. A classmate confessed her feelings for me and we started dating. That night, I decided to tell my mom about it.

"A girl in my class confessed her feelings for me and I'm going out with her now".

"Well... That's great, congratulations, Takkun♪”.

There was a strange pause, but I was relieved to hear a positive response.

And the next day. Mom sees me off at the front door as usual. Yes, even if I have a girlfriend, my relationship with my mom will remain the same.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apadash/aptd_023.html#scene]official site[/url]]
